text:
Maria Chen: Heads up — staging promo is blocked, `staging-e2e` failing 3/4 runs with the same DB connection spike. CI link: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/2987123 :eyes:
Jonah Patel: I saw that, looks like a new transitive gem got pulled in from the ruby-tooling update yesterday. reproduces locally with bundle 2.4.1 for me.
Sarah L: error snippet from the job: `ActiveRecord::ConnectionTimeoutError: could not obtain a connection from the pool` then a bunch of TCP resets.
Kevin H: DeployBot just paused the promotion: "promotion paused — failing checks". Can we pin the gem back to 1.8.2 and re-run?
DeployBot: promotion paused for release/2026-03-20 due to failing pipeline checks (staging-e2e x3). To resume, run `/deploy promote --force` after fixes.
Maria Chen: Agree with pin. Jonah, if you can confirm which gem is the culprit and a minimal repro, we'll pin and re-run. If it's a transitive, we can add a lockfile entry.
Jonah Patel: Minimal repro attached in gist: https://gist.github.com/jpatel/abcd1234 — calls to `pg` driver spike and goroutine-like thread count climbs. Suspect `connection_pool` gem v2.0.0. With v1.8.2 the runs are stable.
Sarah L: Can we do an interim rollback to last-good image while you patch? We have customers on the change window at 11:00.
Kevin H: Last-good image is `image: registry.redwood/inference:2026-03-19-rc3 (sha256:8f3a9b...)`. We can promote that instead of the new build.
Maria Chen: Do that — promote the rc3 image to staging to keep the change window. Also add a release note entry that we pinned ruby deps to avoid regressions.
DeployBot: Promotion request received: promote image sha256:8f3a9b... -> staging. Will start canary and run smoke checks.
Oncall Bot: Notifying SRE oncall @kevin-h for potential DB pool tuning.
Jonah Patel: I'll open a quick PR to pin `connection_pool` to 1.8.2 and add a comment explaining the leak observed with v2.0.0.
Sarah L: PR URL?
Jonah Patel: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/6123 — tests pass locally.
Kevin H: Canary started by DeployBot. Smoke checks passed. Staging e2e re-run queued after pin PR merges.
Maria Chen: OK, plan: 1) promote last-good image to keep change window 2) merge the pin PR and trigger a new build 3) once new build passes staging-e2e twice, swap to new image and update release notes.
Jonah Patel: I'll merge the PR now and kick the build.
DeployBot: promotion complete. Staging now running image sha256:8f3a9b... ; canary status green.
Maria Chen: Thanks — leaving the release pinned until we have two consecutive passing e2e runs. Add a short note to release-notes: "Temporarily pinned connection_pool to 1.8.2 to address intermittent DB pool exhaustion in staging; upgrades postponed."
Sarah L: I'll add that to the release-notes draft and flag for the release manager. :white_check_mark:
Kevin H: If the upgraded gem is required for a security fix, we'll schedule a follow-up with more infra testing rather than force it through the change window.
Jonah Patel: Cool — I'll monitor the new CI and follow up if anything else pops.
Maria Chen: Thanks everyone. I'll update the release ticket and close the loop once swap to new image is successful. :slightly_smiling_face:
